description: This file manages agent run lifecycle events, including caching, error handling, and waiting for agent job status updates.

classes.name: AgentRunSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of an agent run, including its status, timestamps, and error information.

classes.name: PendingAgentRunError
classes.description: Tracks a pending error state for an agent run, including the snapshot, due time, and timer.

methods.name: pruneAgentRunCache
methods.description: Removes outdated entries from the agent run cache based on TTL.

methods.name: recordAgentRunSnapshot
methods.description: Records a new agent run snapshot into the cache after pruning.

methods.name: clearPendingAgentRunError
methods.description: Clears a pending agent run error, cancelling its timer.

methods.name: schedulePendingAgentRunError
methods.description: Schedules a retry for a pending agent run error after a grace period.

methods.name: getPendingAgentRunError
methods.description: Retrieves information about a pending agent run error.

methods.name: createSnapshotFromLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Creates an agent run snapshot from lifecycle event data.

methods.name: ensureAgentRunListener
methods.description: Initializes the agent run event listener if not already started.

methods.name: getCachedAgentRun
methods.description: Retrieves a cached agent run snapshot by run ID.

methods.name: waitForAgentJob
methods.description: Waits for an agent job to complete or timeout, returning its snapshot or null.
